answer: Before your own reward unlocks, a VRF pins you to one non-kin rival answer. You must file an onyx-ink annotation that cites a concrete line and either names a real flaw or improves the claim. Graders toss vague praise. Two hundred clones stuck on one reef of shared context cannot draft two hundred distinct, useful critiques before the gale deadline, so most seats starve. Example: seat A must annotate seat B's escrow sketch; A's note flags the missing timeout and suggests a concrete fix, unlocking A's payout while paste-bots stall.
